notes.title: Rovers Have Arrived!
notes.content:
Blossom just got wheels! Lots of them.

In the latest update, I’ve added fully functional rovers to the game! These handy bots follow you autonomously, and you can chain them together to form full-on rover trains. Better yet, each rover can carry custom modules on top—storage, batteries, solar panels, wind generators—letting you build mobile bases that move with you as you explore the surface of Mars.

This system solves one of the biggest early-game survival problems: limited inventory and power. Now, instead of returning to base constantly, you can bring your base with you.

But that’s not all. I’ve also added:
	• A rideable vehicle that can tow rovers like train cars
	• Modular sockets that make everything part of your power and inventory network
	• Upgraded physics, visual effects, and terrain handling for smoother traversal

You can see everything in action in the newest devlog video, including how the system works behind the scenes and all the funny bugs along the way.

▶ Watch the devlog here: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=n3O_nMbLLxo

Wishlist the game if you haven’t already, and join the community on Discord if you’d like to give feedback or chat game dev!

See you on Mars!
